5844.title: Host plugin toolchain bootstrap lacks its npm runtime
5844.rootCauseOneLine: Both enrolled-host dependency projections omit npm, but a cold plugin toolchain bootstrap requires npm/package.json relative to its packaged CLI bundle.
5844.proposedFix: Carry the existing pinned npm runtime in both host package generators and test pristine packaged-host bootstrap; packaging changes are excluded from this autopilot fix rule.
5844.caveats: Same-agent second clean run; Linux Node 22 rather than macOS Node 26. No live enrollment or completed toolchain download. Reproduction script and normalized output are inline in the HTML. Full workspace build failed outside the host target; scoped host builds and focused toolchain tests passed.
